adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent and deleteEvent, when `externalCalendarId` is falsy the code falls back to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` (and similarly in delete). Since `externalCalendarId` is falsy (e.g., `undefined`/`null`) in that branch, the predicate `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` cannot match any real calendar externalId, so the `find()` will return `undefined`. This removes the previous fallback behavior (`event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` before the refactor) and can cause updates/deletes to target the wrong calendar (likely defaulting elsewhere) or to fail, which aligns with the finding about orphaned/duplicated events when booking references lack `externalCalendarId`.
